prose.text: The block runs the formatter and linter, the agent crate's unit suite (the classifier, the facts, the stamp merge), the root bin's unit layer, the changed integration binaries by name (`cli_verify` is in it: verify's runs change, verification-harness.md 2026-11-17; `contract_ledger_probes` and `cli_version_gate` read the stamps; `contract_lints` pins the moved override's order; `rig_rehearsal` is the V arm's rehearsal), then the whole integration and E2E layers (every stamped binary and the harness boot copy the new `measured`), then the live round for `S0B`, the base live verify of the founder's new cap (Revision 4; S0R, S0R-2 and S0R-3 RED and S0C GREEN, spent, not re-fired): a RED or a `trust-record: fail` stops implement before the operator pass, and a held floor with `trust-record: pass` runs the operator entries (step 30). The release check is not run: no test-only feature, binary or fake-agent code changes (the rig and its ledger are test-only and already refused by it). Every root test that waits keeps the shared 12 s `WITHIN` under the 20 s lint; the verify-driven cases have no test-side bound, the `ci` 20 s kill being theirs (test-plan `decision/verify-driven-tests-20s-kill`), and the `verify_window_` case its moved 80 s. Verify's output feeds the harness boot, so the operator pass boots one session `screen-smoke`, reads its status and cleans it up (boot never piped, verification-harness.md 2025-09-25 addition). No mutation run (inputs#I1 item 8).

The live leg's non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of it: the install read by path and the rig's census, neither of which primes anything. A start refused for the token window is no red to fold: implement stops and says so. The live entry's `failing:` atoms read red when the line is missing, unread, or the version entry holds fewer than the 23 relied rows (step 11, «The floor»).

The remove-the-guard controls are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries (validation.md check 4 (6)), each fired with `--timeout 900`, each control's entry the filtered integration entry below (it builds the workspace, so the clone holds every binary its cases spawn; testing.md 2026-11-13); «holds» means each named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line, and a `timeout` reading is not «holds»: - `fs-trust` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`: the classifier's `trust` arm removed (a trust row reads on   down the arms); case `verify_first_screens_read_trust_then_box_on_the_fake`. With the guard gone the subject   (verify) stamps Run A's first screen as `none`, so the case's `a: trust` fails — measured at implement. - `fs-record` — `src/cmd/verify/typed/runs.rs`: the line storing Run F's reading removed; case   `verify_first_screens_read_trust_then_box_on_the_fake`. With the guard gone Run F's word stamps `null` — measured   at implement. - `fs-boxany` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`: the `box_any` reader's rule-row arm removed; case   `first_screen_facts_count_rows_and_any_box_literal` (fired on the agent crate's unit entry, which builds no root   binary the case needs). With the guard gone a rule row alone reads `box_any` false, so the K1 row reads as K3's —   measured at implement. - `rig-gitroot` — `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/isolate.rs`: the git-root layout step's body removed (nothing written);   case `rig_rehearsal_v_reads_the_trust_record_row_and_no_record_left`. The `git-root` word is read from the disk   (step 6), so with the guard gone the V arm's cwd holds no `.git`, the word reads `absent` and the case's   `git-root: written` fails — measured at implement. Those four held at the stopped run (`evidence/control-1.txt`: `control: 4 holds`); Revision 1 adds two, fired the same way after steps 12–15 are green, their guards' code then in the tree: - `seed-markers` — `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/isolate.rs`: `seed_used_markers`'s merge removed (the body returns   `Ok(())`, nothing written); case `seed_used_markers_writes_the_six_bundle_markers_and_keeps_the_seed`, fired on   `bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --unit` (entry 4, which runs viola-e2e's inline cases). With the guard gone the   config holds the seed's two keys alone and the case's key set fails — measured at implement. - `fs-adjacent` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`: the `rule_above_prompt` reader made to read `false`;   case `first_screen_facts_name_each_literal_its_row_and_the_first_family`, its `rule_above_prompt` row by the name   nextest prints for it (`…::case_{n}_rule_above_prompt`, copied from the first run), fired on entry 3. With the guard   gone that row reads no adjacency — measured at implement. Those two held at the second stopped run (`evidence/control-2.txt`); Revision 2 adds ONE (inputs#I8 item 8: one control at most), fired the same way with `--timeout 900` after steps 17–18 are green: - `vc-nokey` — `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/mod.rs`: the `VC` arm's stop switched from `stop_no_key` to `stop` (the   Ctrl-C presses); case `rig_rehearsal_vc_reads_its_first_frame_at_80x24_and_stops_with_no_key`, fired on entry 5   (its filter holds `binary(rig_rehearsal)`; it builds the workspace, so the clone holds the rig and the fake). With   the guard gone the rig types `\x03` into the child's pty: the fake receipts a key and exits, the summary reads   `stop: ctrl-c 1`, so the case's `stop: killed-no-key` and its no-key assertion fail — measured at implement. That one held at the third stopped run (`evidence/control-3.txt`); Revision 3 adds ONE (inputs#I11 item 2: «one control, its `--timeout` named»), fired the same way with `--timeout 900` after steps 21–24 are green: - `rec-hiddengate` — `src/cmd/verify.rs`: the hidden option's gate removed (the first-screen writer runs on every   failed `--record` verify, the flag or no flag; inputs#I13 item 2); case   `verify_record_on_a_failed_run_writes_no_screen_without_the_rig_option`, fired on entry 5 (its filter holds   `binary(cli_verify)`; it builds the workspace, so the clone holds `viola` and the fake). With the guard gone a plain   failed `--record` verify writes `FirstScreen.f.json` and creates the record dir, so the case's «the record dir does   not exist» fails — measured at implement. That one held at the fourth stopped run (`evidence/control-4.txt`). Revision 4 adds NONE (inputs#I17 item 7: a unit case pins the seeded key set, `seed_used_markers_writes_the_bundle_markers_and_keeps_the_seed`, on entry 4).
